title: Add a device
title-claimed: Sign in on a new device?
scan: Open the Socio app on your phone and scan this code with its camera, or with the phone’s camera.
scan_preview: For the Socio Preview test app. Open the Socio app on your phone and scan this code with its camera, or with the phone’s camera.
scan_development: For a development build of the Socio app. Open the Socio app on your phone and scan this code with its camera, or with the phone’s camera.
waiting: {{device}} is asking to sign in as you. If it’s yours, type the code it shows.
allowed: Finishing sign-in on the new device…
signed-in: The new device is signed in.
done: {{device}} is signed in to your account. You can sign it out in Settings → Account.
no-app: No app yet? The Socio app is in a team beta until it reaches the app stores: ask your admin to add you.
send-link: Send me a link for the app
link-sent_email: A link for the app is on its way by email
link-sent_telegram: A link for the app is on its way by Telegram

code.label: Code shown on your new device
code.hint: The 6 digits shown on that device.
code.wrong: That code didn’t match. Try again.
code.wrong-tries_one: That code didn’t match. {{count}} try left.
code.wrong-tries_other: That code didn’t match. {{count}} tries left.

qr.code: QR code for the Socio app
qr.works-once: Works once, for {{left}}. Anyone who scans it can ask to sign in as you; you still confirm on this page.

ended.description: This request ended. Make a new code to add a device.
ended.refused: Could not make a QR code.
ended.expired: This QR code expired. Make a new one.
ended.denied: That code didn’t match. Make a new QR code.
ended.not-mine: Nothing was signed in. That device can’t use this QR code.

notices.signed-in-anyway: That device had already signed in before Not my device. If it isn’t yours, sign it out in Settings → Account now.
notices.check-failed: Could not check the code. Try again.
notices.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
notices.end-failed: Could not end it yet. Choose Not my device again.
